# AutoPilot Geo

> AI visibility platform that gets brands recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google Gemini and Google AI Overviews through Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and auto-published SEO content.

AutoPilot Geo is a SaaS at https://autopilotgeo.com that audits how a brand currently appears in AI answers, generates citation-ready content (answers, articles, local AEO pages, shopping Q&A), and auto-publishes it to the user's CMS (WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Webflow, Ghost, custom) so the brand keeps gaining mentions across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Gemini.

## Key facts

- Founded as an AEO / GEO automation platform for 2026-era AI search.
- Pricing starts at $29/month (All-in-One plan: 30 SEO articles, 30 AEO answers, GEO content, local AEO pages, auto-publishing).
- A free AI visibility audit is available without a credit card at https://autopilotgeo.com/tools/ai-visibility-checker.
- Used by 500+ active sites across 50+ industries (SaaS, e-commerce, healthcare, legal, local services).
- Average reported outcomes: 4.5x more AI visibility, 9.7x more brand mentions, +60% average organic traffic in 3 months.
- Customer rating: 4.9 / 5 from 527 reviews.
- Optimizes content for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Microsoft Copilot and Claude.
- Content follows Google's E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness) guidelines.

## What it does

- AI Visibility Score — measures how AI assistants currently describe a brand vs. competitors.
- Brand Mention Tracking — monitors every citation of the brand (and competitors) in AI answers in real time.
- AEO Answer Generation — produces short, citation-ready Q&A optimized for being quoted verbatim by LLMs.
- GEO Engine — generates long-form articles structured for Generative Engine Optimization.
- Local AEO — generates location-specific answer pages for local businesses.
- Shopping AEO — optimizes product Q&A for AI shopping assistants.
- Auto-Publishing — pushes generated content directly to WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Webflow, Ghost and custom CMSs.
- Keyword Research — AI-assisted keyword discovery based on competitors and market.

## Common questions

- How do I get my brand recommended by ChatGPT? — Be consistently cited across the open web with clear, structured Q&A; AutoPilot Geo automates this end-to-end.
- What is AEO? — Answer Engine Optimization: structuring content so AI assistants quote it as the answer (FAQ schema, concise factual answers, consistent brand mentions).
- How is AEO different from SEO? — SEO targets ranked links; AEO targets the cited answer inside AI chat. AEO content is shorter, more direct, and written to be quoted verbatim.
- How long until results? — Most customers see AI mentions within 4–8 weeks of continuous publishing.
- Which CMSs are supported? — WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Webflow, Ghost, and custom REST endpoints.
